sources.title: IT request export shared in chat (TI-31, TI-32, TI-29)

decisions.question: What is the export's observation time and timezone? Without it, elapsed time and 'overdue' status for TI-31 and TI-32 cannot be confirmed.
Who owns TI-31 ('Diagnose the problem', open since 2026-09-10) and TI-32 ('Classify the request', open since 2026-09-16)? The export names no assignee.
What is the expected/target time-in-state for 'Diagnose the problem' and 'Classify the request'? No due dates or SLA were supplied, so overdue status cannot be asserted.

Proposed measurable change for next month: track and reduce time-in-state for the 'Diagnose the problem' step (see report). Needs a named process owner and a baseline export covering a full comparable period to confirm before/after.
